tool_descriptions.get_events: Purpose: read complete normalized records for explicit event indices. Useful when a small bounded set is already known and exact text or provenance is needed. Not useful when compact or contextual evidence is already sufficient; do not request an unbounded read. Boundary: returns evidence only and does not determine root cause, prove causality, or perform remediation.
tool_descriptions.filter_by_text: Purpose: find event indices whose message, tag, or component contains supplied text. Useful for bounded discovery when the relevant wording or component is known but indices are not. Not useful when candidate indices are already known or runtime state is needed. Boundary: selects indices only and does not determine root cause, prove causality, or perform remediation.
tool_descriptions.inspect_group_evidence: Purpose: resolve already-suspected compact group IDs into bounded source-local raw evidence with provenance. Useful when compact groups are suspicious but representative metadata is insufficient. Not useful when exact event candidates and enough surrounding context are already available, or when runtime state is required. Boundary: provides evidence only and does not determine root cause, prove causality, or remediate.
tool_descriptions.inspect_failure_context: Purpose: retrieve bounded evidence around an already identified suspicious failure candidate while preserving provenance. Useful when a candidate event has been identified but surrounding diagnostic context is still missing before updating a hypothesis. Not useful when current evidence is sufficient, only runtime state is required, or remediation is requested. Boundary: provides evidence only and does not determine root cause, prove causality, or perform remediation.
tool_descriptions.inspect_process_state: Purpose: read one replay process state by name, pid, or consistent locators. Useful when an uncertainty concerns whether a process exists, is running, or restarted. Not useful for surrounding log context or service dependency readiness. Boundary: read-only evidence; it does not determine root cause, prove causality, restart, kill, or remediate.
tool_descriptions.inspect_service_state: Purpose: read one replay service readiness and dependency state by name. Useful when an uncertainty concerns service health, readiness, or required dependencies. Not useful for raw log context, process identity, cgroup state, or mount state. Boundary: read-only evidence; it does not determine root cause, prove causality, or remediate.
tool_descriptions.inspect_cgroup_state: Purpose: read one replay cgroup resource state by name. Useful when an uncertainty concerns memory limits, pressure, or cgroup kill counters. Not useful for service readiness or surrounding logs. Boundary: read-only evidence; it does not determine root cause, prove causality, change limits, or remediate.
tool_descriptions.inspect_mount_state: Purpose: read one replay mount state by path. Useful when an uncertainty concerns whether a required path is available or read-only. Not useful for process or service readiness or surrounding logs. Boundary: read-only evidence; it does not determine root cause, prove causality, mount, unmount, write, or remediate.
tool_descriptions.discover_runtime_entities: Purpose: list canonical process, service, or mount identifiers present in the replay runtime snapshot. Useful before an inspection when the valid name or path is unknown. Not useful when a canonical identifier is already known or for interpreting failure meaning. Boundary: read-only identity evidence only; it does not infer missing entities, determine root cause, prove causality, recommend actions, or remediate.
